name: Connect Square Payments – WordPress Square Hosted Checkout for WooCommerce, Fluent Forms, CF7, WPForms, Pay Links & More
author: WPPayments

sections.description:
Connect Square Payments is the most reliable WooCommerce Square alternative that adds a professional Square payment gateway using Square Hosted Checkout.

  • New — Connect Square Payments App (Android): Optional companion app — scan a QR code from the Mobile App admin screen to monitor today’s Square sales and connection status on your phone. APK download link in plugin settings; no Square credentials stored in the app.
  • Square Online users: Switch to WooCommerce and keep Square for payments.
    Need help migrating? Install the plugin and open a support request — we can
    assist with product sync, store setup, and payment configuration.

Send buyers to Square’s secure hosted payment page — no card fields in your theme, no JavaScript conflicts, and a permanent fix for common payment nonce is missing or EMPTY_VALUE errors on WooCommerce checkout and Pay for Order pages.

Connect Square once and accept payments across your entire WordPress site:
* WooCommerce Square gateway (classic and Blocks checkout)
* Paid Memberships Pro (recurring memberships without WooCommerce Subscriptions)
* Fluent Forms, Contact Form 7 (CF7), and WPForms
* Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, MetForm, SureForms, and Forminator
* Square Payment Links (buttons for Gutenberg, Elementor, Beaver Builder, and shortcodes)
* Square Subscriptions for recurring billing

Why merchants choose this plugin:

If you searched for Square payment for WordPress, you have probably seen on-site card fields break after a theme update or plugin conflict. Connect Square Payments is a no-code integration: connect Square once, enable the gateway, and send buyers to Square Hosted Checkout — no card form embedded in your theme.

  • Fix WooCommerce Square nonce error: Hosted checkout removes failure points like square-credit-card.js conflicts, session timeouts, and EMPTY_VALUE on Pay for Order pages.
  • Digital wallets included: Apple Pay, Google Pay, Cash App Pay, and Afterpay / Clearpay (BNPL) supported on Square’s page.
  • No extra platform fees: You pay Square’s normal processing rates only; no per-transaction plugin fee.
  • Reliable Inventory Sync: Simple SKU-based stock sync updates Square On hand when WooCommerce orders are paid.
  • POS orders in Woo (Pro): Bring Square in-person sales into WooCommerce as orders. Creates Woo products for new Square items, links them to the order, and reduces stock.
  • Proactive Connection Alerts (Free): Daily token health checks plus email and wp-admin notices when Square OAuth refresh fails or API calls report an expired or revoked token — reconnect before checkout breaks.

Features

  • Hosted checkout — customers pay on Square’s secure page and return to your store.
  • Refunds from wp-admin — full or partial refunds directly on the WooCommerce order screen.
  • Pay for Order links — email or copy a secure invoice payment link for unpaid orders.
  • Payment sync — automatically check pending orders and mark them paid without needing complex webhooks.
  • Customer sync — keep Square and WordPress customer directories in sync automatically.
  • Square Loyalty Rewards — earn points on all paid orders (Free); redeem at checkout (Premium).
  • Proactive connection alerts (Free) — email and wp-admin notice when Square OAuth renewal fails or tokens are rejected.
  • Automatic OAuth token renewal — daily refresh cron keeps access tokens current.
  • 24/7 Support — dedicated help via email, WhatsApp, and the WordPress.org forum.

Premium features

Upgrade under Payments Square Connect → Pricing to unlock:
* Location stock — link products to specific Square locations for accurate inventory.
* Bulk Location stock admin — manage locations and stock levels for your entire catalog at once.
* Square gift cards at checkout.
* Loyalty reward redemption directly on the checkout page.
* Bi-directional inventory (Square → WooCommerce) for real-time stock updates.
* Order import from Square (Pro) — optionally create WooCommerce orders when Square POS / Register payments complete.
* Dispute alerts (Plus) — email admin and show dashboard notices when Square chargebacks/disputes arrive.
* Payout reconciliation (Pro) — log payout webhooks and link recent WooCommerce orders.
* Refund sync (Pro) — Square Dashboard refunds create matching WooCommerce refunds with stock restoration.
* Terminal checkout sync (Pro) — complete or cancel WooCommerce orders when Square Terminal checkout status changes.
* And many more — see Payments Square Connect → Pricing for the full Plus and Pro feature list.

Looking for Square on Odoo?

This plugin is for WordPress / WooCommerce. If you need a Square solution on Odoo instead — inventory sync, multi-location stock, Square Hosted Checkout, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Cash App Pay, Afterpay, and Square Terminal — use our free Odoo module Square Sync & Pay.

Same team (WPPayments). No module subscription fee — you only pay Square’s normal processing rates.
sections.installation:
→ Getting started guide

  1. Activate Payments Square Connect.
  2. Open Payments Square Connect in the admin sidebar.
  3. Choose Sandbox or Live, sign in with Square, and save a location.
  4. Enable WooCommerce Square checkout, or your preferred form plugin integration.
sections.faq:
Payment nonce is missing — can hosted checkout fix it?

Yes. The payment nonce is missing error usually happens when Square’s on-site JavaScript cannot tokenize the card due to theme conflicts or caching. Connect Square Payments avoids on-site nonce generation entirely by using Square Hosted Checkout.

How is hosted checkout different from on-site Square card fields?

Many Square integrations embed card fields in your checkout theme. Connect Square Payments uses Square Hosted Checkout (off-site), which can be more reliable for sites with complex themes or caching. We also support WPForms, Fluent Forms, and CF7 on the same connection.

Do Square POS sales create WooCommerce orders?

Not by default. On Pro, enable Order import (Square → WooCommerce) under connection settings. Completed Square/POS payments for your selected location can create WooCommerce orders. Existing products match by SKU or catalog link; new WooCommerce products are created for unmatched Square catalog lines, linked to the order, and stock is reduced. Custom/ad-hoc POS lines also create simple products when possible.

Can I get alerts when a Square dispute is opened?

On Plus, enable Dispute alerts under connection settings. When Square sends a dispute webhook, the store admin gets an email and a WooCommerce admin notice with amount, reason, and dispute state.

Will I be notified if my Square connection drops?

Yes — free on all plans. Payments Square Connect runs daily OAuth token checks and emails the site admin (plus shows a wp-admin notice) when token refresh fails or Square rejects the stored access token. Reconnect under Payments Square Connect → Connect to restore checkout.

Does this work with Apple Pay and Google Pay?

Yes. Enable digital wallets under Payments Square Connect → Checkout Settings. Buyers will see Apple Pay, Google Pay, Cash App Pay, and Afterpay on the Square payment page.

Does Square payment work in the USA, UK, and Australia?

Yes. Square payment and Square Hosted Checkout work for merchants in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, Ireland, France, Spain, and Japan.
sections.changelog:
1.3.57

  • New (Free) — Connect Square Payments Android app: pair your store from Payments Square Connect → Mobile App via QR code.

1.3.56

  • Fix — Google Pay express button renders correctly on checkout and product pages, including WooCommerce Blocks checkout.
  • Fix — Cart express wallet buttons no longer stay hidden inside the Blocks cart mount.
  • Fix — Express wallet button spacing on cart and product pages now matches WooCommerce Square (spacing below Proceed to Checkout / Add to Cart, full-width cart totals, consistent button gaps).
  • Improvement — Clearer Apple Pay domain verification alerts and wp-admin connection notices when domain registration needs attention.

1.3.54

  • Fix — Express wallet buttons (Google Pay / Apple Pay) on cart and product pages: proper spacing below Proceed to Checkout / Add to Cart, full-width layout in cart totals, and consistent button gaps (WooCommerce Square parity).

1.3.50

  • Apple Pay gateway (Free) — on-site checkout (classic + Blocks), domain verification, refunds.
  • Google Pay gateway (Free) — on-site checkout (classic + Blocks); enable separately from Apple Pay.
  • Express checkout (Free) — wallet buttons on cart, product, and checkout (toggle per gateway).
  • Apple Pay / Google Pay Blocks fixes — WC 10+ onPaymentSetup registration, correct Store API payment hook, token cache race fix, and less Blocks debug noise.
  • Apple Pay button & debug — native Apple Pay button styling, optional debug logging (?error-logapple=true), tokenize audit in order notes and WooCommerce logs.
  • Human-readable wallet errors — Square decline messages (e.g. transaction limit, card declined) instead of generic “Something went wrong” on Blocks checkout.

1.3.48

  • Connection alerts (Free) — email the site admin and show a wp-admin reconnect notice when Square OAuth token refresh fails or API calls report an expired/revoked token. Includes daily cron monitoring and automatic alert clearing after a successful reconnect.

1.3.47

  • Update — Freemius SDK 2.13.4 (Pricing App fixes, PHP compatibility, configurable API timeout).

1.3.46

  • Premium webhooks (Plus/Pro) — dispute email and admin alerts (Plus); payout reconciliation log, Square Dashboard → WooCommerce refund sync, and Terminal checkout order sync (Pro). Uses the Payments Square Connect webhook relay (no merchant webhook setup).
  • Connect settings — toggles for dispute alerts, payout reconciliation, refund sync, and Terminal sync.
  • Order import (Pro) — Square POS line items match existing products or create new WooCommerce products; stock reduced on import; order notes show matched/created lines.

1.3.45

  • Order import (Pro) — when a Square/POS order imports, create or match a WooCommerce customer and link the order (email / Square customer ID).

1.3.44

  • Fix — Connect settings checkboxes for Location stock, Inventory sync, and Order import now save correctly when enabled.

1.3.43

  • Order import (Pro) — optionally import completed Square POS / Square payments into WooCommerce as new orders (enable under connection settings).

1.3.42

  • Location stock (Plus) — link each product to one Square location for online sales.
  • Location stock admin — bulk screen to change locations and stock for many products at once.

1.3.41

  • Plans — Free / Plus / Pro (annual) tiers.
  • Plus — gift cards at checkout, loyalty redeem, and location-linked stock.

1.3.40

  • Square Loyalty Rewards — earn Square Loyalty points on paid WooCommerce orders (Free).
  • OAuth — request LOYALTY_READ and LOYALTY_WRITE scopes.
